known_limitations: Twenty completed closes, population standard deviation and two deviations form the bands. BandWidth=(upper-lower)/positive middle. Rolling minimum requires 125 mature BandWidths, not 125 raw bars. First current availability is observation index 144; zero-width history may be a squeeze, but an actual strict breakout still needs a price move.

Zero buffer including ties, previous-five-observation squeeze, fresh strict current breakout and last-six contiguous bars are laboratory adaptations. They do not reproduce the manual's proprietary implementation or default three-percent buffer. Older history uses observed bars, not a claim of continuous calendar coverage.

BUY needs previous close at or below its upper band then current close strictly above its own upper band and previous close; SELL is symmetric. A band tag, repeated outside close, opposite-direction candidate, missing or immature observation does not confirm entry.

This is a distinct normalized BandWidth alternative to the old disjoint 5/20 true-range proxy, not a silent replacement. Original closed OHLC and observation clock are authoritative; supplied method columns cannot create observations.

The exact trend-up/London/normal scope, periods and signal conditions are prospective research hypotheses. Risk, leverage, stops, target, spread, slippage, commission and other eligibility guards remain unchanged. Research on reused pre-2026 data is not untouched validation, Master, useful causal skill, credit or paper/live permission. All 2026 and later market data remain paper-only.
